taxes.statute: Stamp Duties Act Cap. 43:01 s. 36 (conveyance on sale) and Schedule item 7, Schedule replaced by the Stamp Duties Order 2020 (G.N. 86 of 2020, Malawi Gazette Supplement 23 October 2020; commons.laws.africa copy via Wayback 2024-08-03, R4/fetch/p15/mw_stamp_order_gn86_2020.pdf, page 442 read on the page image); the 2014 consolidation (MalawiLII, R4/fetch/p15/mw_sda_2014.txt) had K1.50 per K100. Liability: 'the purchaser or transferee' (Schedule column)
unsupported: 'for any fractional part of K100' rounding up not applied (at most K3)
the fixed amounts for considerations up to K200
Stamp Duties Orders after 2020 not checked (flag)
conveyances of property other than land and buildings (shares: marketable securities items)
voluntary dispositions (s. 43) charged as conveyances on the value: gifts not modelled

taxes.statute: Pension Act No. 6 of 2023 s. 12 (1) (held mw/law/w5/pension_act_6_2023.txt); US SSA, Social Security Programs Throughout the World (SSPTW), Africa 2019 — Malawi
taxes.why: MW has no public social-insurance fund: the Pension Act 2023 s. 12 (1) requires 'a minimum of ten per cent by the employer' to a mandatory occupational pension scheme, i.e. individual accounts in privately managed funds (SSPTW: 'Mandatory individual account system'); a compulsory payment to a private fund is not a tax (OECD) and is not modelled. Sickness, maternity and work injury are employer-liability systems through private carriers.

taxes.tax: Customs import duty (applied tariff, WTO IDB 2025)
taxes.statute: customs tariff of Malawi as notified to the WTO IDB for 2025; WTO Integrated Database (IDB), applied tariff notified by Malawi for 2025 (HS 2022), read on the WTO Tariff & Trade Data browse pages (ttd.wto.org/en/data/idb/applied-duties?member=C454&product=<line>&year=2025, retrieved 2026-11-21; customs/packs/mw.json)
unsupported: only the HS subheadings of customs/HS_MAP.md are modelled (any other code: grade C, no tariff line)
IDB notification year 2025: a change of the tariff during 2025 (budget measures, stays of application) is not dated
national import levies and charges outside the customs duty column (statistical, processing, ECOWAS/AU levies, import VAT advance) not modelled
the price is taken before VAT and duty only: an excise inside the price needs "customsValue"
